label: Danciu & Tselentis (2007)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Danciu & Tselentis (2007)

site.note: Use the paper's own categories. Do not translate them into NGA-style classes.
site.anchor_note: RESOLVED: one coefficient e multiplies S, and S takes the values 0/1/2 -- an ordinal term, not a binary one. The earlier 'binary' reading from the anchor was wrong. Note the gap 665 < Vs30 <= 800 m/s is not covered by any class.

mechanism.anchor_note: RESOLVED (Douglas section 2.242): thrust and strike-slip share F = 1, normal is F = 0.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table. PGA coefficients a, b, c, h, e_site, f_fault are now available.

implementation_notes: Range warnings for the Greek calibration envelope: Mw ~4.5-6.9, Repi to ~136 km.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Mediterranean regional model using epicentral distance.

aleatory.warning: The appendix labels these 'aleatory_as_labelled_by_douglas' - the intra/inter naming in the catalogue looks transposed. Do not assume the usual convention; check the paper before using either term.

resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code A (arithmetic mean of the two horizontals)
